# Clip lines — for Vitaly's approval

<!-- generated by `npm run assetgen -- lines --write` from assets/manifest.yaml; edit the manifest, not this file -->

Every fixed line that will be synthesised (SLNG TTS) before the event. Speaking clips are

Live roast lines are not here — those are generated at runtime.
